test_title: PYST 05: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 11 Dec 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that gives the most appropriate meaning of the underlined word.

Jack was given the responsibility of driving, as he was the only __teetotaller__.

options.text: Person with imagination and creative potential
Person who completely abstains from intoxicating drinks like alcohol
Person who habitually drinks to the point of losing control
Responsible citizen of the country with high self-esteem

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. "Person who completely abstains from intoxicating drinks like alcohol".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Teetotaller"** refers to a person who abstains from consuming alcohol completely. (शराब न पीने वाला व्यक्ति)

 
 
• **Example:** As a teetotaller, he prefers fruit juice over wine at social gatherings.
 
 
 
• Here, Jack was given the responsibility of driving because he does not consume alcohol, which aligns with the meaning of "teetotaller".

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Person who completely abstains from intoxicating drinks like alcohol**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Person with imagination and creative potential **(कल्पनाशील और रचनात्मक क्षमता वाला व्यक्ति)

 
 
• **Example:** A writer is often a person with great imagination and creative potential.
 
 
 
• **Person who habitually drinks to the point of losing control **(नियमित रूप से अत्यधिक शराब पीने वाला व्यक्ति)
 
 
• **Example:** His habit of drinking excessively led to serious health issues.
 
 
 
• **Responsible citizen of the country with high self-esteem **(देश का जिम्मेदार नागरिक जिसमें उच्च आत्म-सम्मान हो)
 
 
• **Example:** A responsible citizen always abides by the laws of the country.
 
 

4b:T735,
The correct answer is **Option 2**.
